The '''Sulorine system''' was located in the [[Suolriep sector/Legends|Suolriep sector]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sulorine/Legends|Sulorine]].<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/30387023|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2009-08-28|time=11:05 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180225165344/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-109}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Jason Fry noted that the planet of [[Sulorine/Legends|Sulorine]], as included in the novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']], was a typo of Suolriep, but that it was decided to keep it as a separate planet altogether.<ref name="JCF" />
